lines.en: I'm sorry, are you leaving? I thought we had a meeting.
No, we do. It's just, I think it's a little chilly in here.
Are you okay? Your eyes are glassy.
Oh my God. Oh my... Is she sick? Are you sick?
That's why I'm wearing this and misting myself with hand sanitizer.
I'm not sick. I just have allergies, okay?
I took a Claritin and I threw that up.
So I took another one, I threw that up,
and then I took a third and it stayed down.
I have to get out of here.
A grain of sand could destroy it.
No, I can't. I can't go home.
I have to get ready for the Chamber of Secrets.
If this meeting does not go perfectly,
then the Harvest Festival is going to be over before I begin.
And she's the most beautiful nurse in the world.
Now it's really hot in here.
Leslie, I typed your symptoms into the thing up here
and it says you could have network connectivity problems.
If I was sick, could I do this?
I've done presentations like this before and Tom will be with me.
It's not that I don't trust Ben.
It's that I don't have faith in Ben.
And also I'm starting to forget who Ben is.
Okay, so let's talk about your opening remarks.
Do you want me to write you a rap?
You're never going to be able to pull it off.
How about a show tune or something?
I was just planning to introduce myself non-musically
and then get everyone to refer to their packets
You need to go over every single detail with me.
Leslie, I promise you I won't half-ass this.
I think my fever just broke.
Hey, that flu medicine really helped.
I feel a thousand percent better.
I don't want to look stuffy,
but I also don't want to look too schlubby.
No, I'm going to that meeting.
Either you get back in the bed
or I will strap you down.
Maybe we should get the suite here for him, okay?
Can I get some money for the cab
that I took over here, please?
and it had Egyptian hieroglyphics on it.
Do you know the exchange rate?
The floor and the wall just switched.
You know, I find it a little insulting
that you don't trust me to handle this.
It's not that I don't trust you, okay?
It's just this Harvest Festival is my project.
It's my career on the line.
And I just need to make sure
that I've done everything I can to make it work.
Okay, I wouldn't open with that.
